dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Ah, what a lovely day! Well, are you ready for a taste of the bartender life?

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Wonderful! I wish you good luck today as well.

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem. Please come back whenever you've got the time.

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Well, this activity was originally intended to enlist new talent for our tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: The drinkers are many, but those who mix drinks are few. Charles can barely get a single day off all year...

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: As such, we started this event to help drum up interest in the bartending occupation!

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: What do you think, Traveler? What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Aha, that's what I love to hear! Guess this was all worth it!

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, the atmosphere in the tavern while you were there was great. In fact, the streets have been filled with customers this entire time...

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: And while this wasn't our original intention, all's well that ends well, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Luka
dialogues.text: Ah, I see, I suppose the work was quite difficult.
